bearerAuth.description: Opaque random session token; server stores only hash.

accessToken.description: Opaque access token; store in memory/secure platform storage; never log.

Snapshot.description: Exact wire fields mirror RunSnapshot in types.ts; all physics coordinates DU. Schema is not a substitute for server verification.

Finish.description: Final small log tail plus final snapshot. Earlier commands/events must be acknowledged using POST logs. Server verifies complete stored sequence; never silently truncates a long unlimited run.
